title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that all workforce members have access to documentation defining the cybersecurity safeguards related to their roles and responsibilities.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Maintain a technology platform for delivering cybersecurity-related education to workforce members, such as a Learning Management System (LMS).

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Maintain a technology platform, such as a Learning Management System (LMS), for tracking cybersecurity-related education delivered to workforce members.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that all workforce members, including engineers, developers, and privileged users, regularly receive appropriate education on cybersecurity safeguards related to their roles and responsibilities.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that all workforce members regularly receive appropriate cybersecurity awareness training related to their roles and responsibilities.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the cybersecurity education program appropriately educates workforce members on securely authenticating to information systems.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the cybersecurity education program appropriately educates workforce members on securely communicating over untrusted networks.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the cybersecurity education program appropriately educates workforce members on securely handling data, including the most likely reasons data may be exposed.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the cybersecurity education program appropriately educates workforce members on securely responding to social engineering techniques, including identifying and handling such activities.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the cybersecurity education program appropriately educates workforce members on securely reporting cybersecurity safeguard failures.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the cybersecurity education program appropriately educates workforce members on securely reporting potential cybersecurity incidents to the organization.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Regularly perform educational activities that reinforce the cybersecurity education program and validate the effectiveness of the program.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Regularly validate the effectiveness of the cybersecurity education program using quantifiable measures that can be reported to business stakeholders.

title: Education Management Policy
definition: Regularly report the results of validating the effectiveness of the cybersecurity education program to business stakeholders.
